title: 第9章 他身上臭臭的不太好闻第10章 衣物师尊的奖励么那收下吧
slug: 师尊修为尽失后宠妻系统来了
content_zh:
第9章他身上臭臭的，不太好闻离谱归离谱。
楚宁也是硬着头皮收下了。
妻子.......
系统一提示，楚宁看苏婉卿的眼神都不对了。
这笑的，实在撩人......
甚至忍不住回想起昨晚.......
唉！他果然非尊师重道之正人君子啊，这系统搞的也是够够的了。
虽然有点吐槽，但苏婉卿的确是美的动人心魄。
可如今，正是苏婉卿毫无修为之际，她已经没了任何人可以相信，唯有他一个。
此刻若是暴露，怕不是真的让苏婉卿这般骄傲之人彻底没了心气，也会觉得他说的那番话只是为了得到苏婉卿的好感。
那番话，的确是一个弟子不想当师尊轻生所说。
当年，她也是受到过苏婉卿的教诲，年纪小小的，就对长生抱有渴望，可知道自己资质没那么好。
那年，苏婉卿轻抚他的脑袋，笑着说，纵然你此生修行无望，只要跟在为师身后，就无人能动你分毫。
那种自信，那种为人师者的关切，才是楚宁如今有点拧巴的原因。
罢了！
反正宠就对了！
帮助恢复体魄，也算是宠妻的一部分了！
当年师尊站在自己身前，如今就换成他，为师尊遮风挡雨！
楚宁起身，接过了苏婉卿递过来的飞剑。
“飘渺剑诀，可还记得？”

苏婉卿神情逐渐严肃，目光落在楚宁身上，于剑道之上，她格外严苛，前后变化，根本不似一人。
又是那当年威压天下的剑道天骄，令世人黯然失色的模样。
“为师飘渺剑诀，为太玄宗太虚剑诀所改进。”
“本源剑术法，道心坚韧而剑术飘渺，一朝得道可入青云，剑术有八十一篇。”
“宁儿，你且以刺、斩、撩、劈、斩这剑术基本手段展示为师。”
剑术，和术法差不多，横竖撇捺点，主要是这些东西的连贯。
可最基础的，只有这些，练到炉火纯青的地步才能感受到剑意，才能连贯。
楚宁立刻按照脑海中曾经练过的记载开始出剑，他如今二境修为，出剑虎虎生风，自己觉得倒是能用以作为杀人技了。
可苏婉卿看得，那叫一个头大。
破绽百出。
站姿都有问题，直接是把剑当刀了，剑道本就讲究以柔克刚之技，即便是刚猛之剑，也绝非力道刚猛，而是剑身刚猛。
欸.......弟子这剑道，果然当时让弟子学习其他淬体术法是好的，他如果走这条路，怕是淬体都很困难。
苏婉卿已经看出了楚宁的剑道天赋了，同样是看出了楚宁的剑道底蕴如何。
即便是修为高了，对于剑道的天赋，仍然不能说是高。
倘若如今开始修行，花费的时间和精力那可就是太大了，但好过日后修行的路数多了，对于剑道就再也没办法感悟了。
女子面色清冷，眼神严肃，就这么盯着楚宁的双眼。
“可真的要学剑？”
楚宁当即拱手。
“弟子愿为师尊传承飘渺剑诀，同样的，弟子也更想在剑道之上有所造诣。”
“此心，可诚？”
content_en:
Chapter 9 He stinks, it doesn’t smell good, it’s outrageous.
Chu Ning also accepted it bravely.
Wife.......
As soon as the system prompted, Chu Ning looked at Su Wanqing and her eyes were wrong.
This smile is really tempting...
I can't even help but think back to last night...
Alas! He is indeed not an upright gentleman who respects his teachers and values ​​his teachings. This system has done enough.
Although it's a bit of a complaint, Su Wanqing is indeed breathtakingly beautiful.
But now, when Su Wanqing has no cultivation, she has no one to trust but him.
If exposed at this moment, I am afraid that if it really makes a proud person like Su Wanqing completely lose his temper, he will also think that what he said was just to gain Su Wanqing's favor.
Those words were indeed spoken by a disciple who did not want his master to commit suicide.
Back then, she had also been taught by Su Wanqing. At a young age, she had longed for immortality, but she knew that her qualifications were not that good.
That year, Su Wanqing stroked his head and said with a smile, even if you have no hope of practicing in this life, as long as you follow my teacher, no one can touch you.
That kind of confidence, that kind of concern as a teacher, is the reason why Chu Ning is a little nervous now.
That’s it!
Anyway, just love it!
Helping to restore the body is also part of doting on your wife!
Back then, the master stood in front of him, but now it was him, protecting him from the wind and rain!
Chu Ning stood up and took the flying sword handed over by Su Wanqing.
"The Misty Sword Art, do you still remember it?"
Su Wanqing's expression gradually became serious, and her eyes fell on Chu Ning. She was particularly strict in the way of swordsmanship, and she looked different from the same person at all.
It's the appearance of the swordsman prodigy who once dominated the world and overshadowed the world.
"I am a master of Piaomiao Sword Technique, which was improved by Taixuan Sect's Taixu Sword Technique."
"The original swordsmanship method, the Taoist heart is tenacious and the swordsmanship is ethereal. Once you master the Tao, you can enter the Qingyun. There are eighty-one chapters on swordsmanship."
"Ning'er, you should become a master by demonstrating the basic skills of swordsmanship such as stabbing, cutting, teasing, splitting and slashing."
Swordsmanship is almost the same as magic. A little bit about the vertical and horizontal aspects, the main thing is the coherence of these things.
But these are the most basic things. Only when you practice to a proficient level can you feel the meaning of the sword and be coherent.
Chu Ning immediately started to draw the sword according to the records in his mind. He was now in the second level of cultivation, and he could use the sword as a killing technique.
But Su Wanqing could see that it was a big head.
Full of flaws.
There is a problem with the stance, and the sword is used as a sword. Kendo emphasizes the technique of using softness to overcome strength. Even if the sword is strong, it is not strong in strength, but strong in the blade.
Well... As for the disciple's swordsmanship, it was really good for him to learn other body tempering techniques at that time. If he took this path, it would be very difficult for him to temper the body.
Su Wanqing has already seen Chu Ning's talent in swordsmanship, and she has also seen Chu Ning's background in swordsmanship.
Even if his cultivation level is high, his talent for swordsmanship still cannot be said to be high.
If you start practicing now, it will take too much time and energy, but it will be better than having many ways to practice in the future, and you will no longer be able to understand the way of the sword.
The woman had a cold face and serious eyes, staring into Chu Ning's eyes.
"Do you really want to learn the sword?"
Chu Ning immediately handed over.
"This disciple is willing to pass on the Piaomiao Sword Technique to the Master. Similarly, I also want to achieve more in the way of swordsmanship."
"Is this sincere?"
